summary: The candidate planning diff for T049 is narrowly scoped to a single CONTRACT_MISMATCH repair: the first Deliverable path is relocated from the protected `docs/spec/strategy/V4_POSITION_SIZING.md` to the Developer-authorable `docs/implement/strategy/V4_POSITION_SIZING.md`. Only `todo/phases/P05-features-and-valuation/T049.md` is edited in contract text (Deliverables paragraph only). The other sections (Dependencies, Numeraire boundary, Outcome, Acceptance, Must-not, References, Contract status banner) are byte-identical between base and candidate. The new path is outside the controller's PROTECTED_PREFIXES (`docs/implement/` is not in the set, while `docs/spec/` is), so the Developer can satisfy the spec-text obligation in the same attempt as the integer implementation. The accompanying `todo/config.yaml` changes (`workflow_state: PLANNING -> AWAITING_PLAN_REVIEW` and `T049.status: PLANNING -> AWAITING_PLAN_REVIEW`) are the controller-managed transitions that `finish-plan` writes when sealing the planning candidate, not planner inventions; attempt counter, base_commit, candidate_commit, approved_commit, latest_review, evidence pointer, depends_on, agent_runtime model and dependency manifests are all untouched. The new `todo/evidence/P05/T049/attempt-001-planner.json` is the structured planner handoff with outcome `PLAN_READY` and its rationale correctly traces the protected-prefix collision back to `tools/workflow/core.py` lines 80-87 and the planning-scope rule at lines 2566-2583. The change is proportionate to the triaged `CONTRACT_MISMATCH` issue (one Deliverable path; no acceptance, must-not, or reference edits; no Spec or Intent scope creep), consistent with the higher-priority Developer-side implementation already recorded in attempt-001-developer.json (which passes pytest, ruff check, ruff format --check, and strict mypy on non-protected paths), and stays inside the CONTRACT-layer planning scope defined in WORKFLOW.md.
